## Provenance counts

| Type | Monthly metric records |
|---|---:|
| MISSING | 0 |
| MODELLED_AREA_SCENARIO | 108 |
| OBSERVED_OFFICIAL | 828 |
| SHARED_SYNTHETIC_BASELINE | 2844 |
| VERIFIED_RESEARCH | 0 |

VERIFIED_RESEARCH administrative context is stored in the area registry, not invented as a monthly numeric series.
The two new areas have pm10_ug_m3 compatibility aliases for pm10_station_ug_m3. Both reference the same evidence; do not double count.
BDL observations have no exact numeric value. Date precision and raw results are retained.
Water quality: 451 canonical parameter records, 471 evidence records, including 20 corroborations. River, groundwater and distribution are separate media.
See missing_data_report.json for evidence gaps even where a shared baseline has complete numeric coverage.
See air_candidate_verification.csv for seven distinct source disagreements retained from both workbook and CSV.
